section: 40.5 Closure constructions and dynamic presentations (duty MP-0)
placement_note: Chapter 40 order: 064 (40.1), 065 (40.2), 067 (40.4) before this file, 069 onward after it. The body opens with \chapter per the packet heading level.

duties.written: Rigid and safe extensions over a root set (incl. the safe-or-rigid dichotomy the source omits on p. 12); algorithmic and minimal-set t-closure with equivalence and well-definedness; closure type as a first-order formula incl. t = 0; Nonexistence Lemma; Finite Closure Lemma with complete proof; examples and failure boundaries; dynamic view (f_A, continuity, distinct T_alpha, spectra, clique spectra, every finite set of rationals a spectrum).
duties.remaining: The p. 15 claim that for every rational a/b a graph H has threshold n^{-a/b} is not proved; the axiomatized almost sure theory is cited.
